subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of Eastern Ghats peak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendragiri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahendragiri** is one of the prominent peaks in the Eastern Ghats.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast, spanning from Odisha to Tamil Nadu.
 
• Mahendragiri, located in the Gajapati district of Odisha, is the second highest peak in the Eastern Ghats, standing at an elevation of 1,501 meters (4,925 feet
